title: PHP 7.3.20 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.3.20. This is a security release impacting the of PHP.official Windows builds

For windows users running an official build, this release contains a patched version of addressing .libcurlCVE-2020-8169

For all other consumers of PHP, this is a bug fix release.

All PHP 7.3 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 7.3.20 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
